recognize_zh: 中倍下可見淋巴組織中有一片細胞核較大、呈卵圓形淡染的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）聚集，周圍環繞小淋巴球，屬於非特異性的反應性變化，需配合螺旋體染色才能指向梅毒。
features: Vaguely nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Surrounding cuffs of small, dark, round lymphocytes
Scattered plasma cells and intermediate-sized cells without significant atypia
Occasional small vessels; no necrosis or multinucleated giant cells in this field
Polymorphous reactive composition without monotonous sheets of atypical cells
describe_en: Medium-power H&E section of lymphoid tissue shows a vaguely nodular collection of epithelioid histiocytes with oval vesicular nuclei and pale cytoplasm, surrounded by small mature lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells. No necrosis, multinucleated giant cells, or sheets of cytologically atypical large cells are identified. The appearance is that of a non-specific reactive lymphadenitis with an epithelioid histiocytic component. In the context of syphilitic lymphadenitis these findings are compatible, but they are not specific; Treponema immunostain, special stains for other organisms, and serology are required.

ddx.vs: Toxoplasmosis shows small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes encroaching on reactive germinal centers with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, without capsular fibrosis or spirochetes.
These show well-formed granulomas often with caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, confirmed by AFB or GMS stains.
NLPHL shows large nodules containing scattered LP (popcorn) cells that are CD20+ and PAX5+, not an epithelioid histiocyte aggregate with bland lymphocytes.
Sarcoidosis has numerous tight non-necrotizing granulomas with giant cells and asteroid bodies, and is a diagnosis of exclusion after organism stains.
